title: Accept the terms again
summary: Blocks the app until the person accepts the current Terms of use and Privacy policy, for accounts made before the clickwrap and after a new legalVersion (ADR 0113).

acceptedVersion.description: terms_version from GET /v1/me/account. Absent for accounts made before ADR 0113.

currentVersion.description: legalVersion from registries/legal.json (or terms_version from GET /v1/signup/config when newer).

check.effect: After sign-in and on foreground: when acceptedVersion differs from currentVersion, shows this screen over the app.

openTerms.effect: Opens the Terms of use in the system browser (termsPath or enTermsPath on PUBLIC_SITE_URL).

openPrivacy.effect: Opens the Privacy policy the same way (privacyPath or enPrivacyPath).

accept.effect: Sends POST /v1/me/terms with currentVersion. On 204 closes. Off while accepted is false.

notes: The app never sends an acceptance that the person did not tick.
The screen has no close button. A text button at the bottom (bipe_account_sign_out) opens the sign-out confirm of settings, so a person who does not accept can leave.
Bipe logic: BipeAPIClient.acceptTerms, BipeLegalLinks (iOS); BipeTermsReaccept, BipeTermsReacceptPresenter, BipeLegalLinks (Android).
